frameworks.change: Drop net8.0 and net472. Three #if NETFRAMEWORK branches in ExcelDocument.Save.Public.cs (lines 384, 526, 596: non-seekable destination handling on .NET Framework System.IO.Packaging) and one NETSTANDARD2_0 || NETFRAMEWORK branch in Read/ExcelSheetReader.NumericParsing.cs must become runtime checks or netstandard2.0 code paths. 48 NET8_0_OR_GREATER and 57 NET5+/NETCOREAPP conditions remain valid under net10.0. System.Text.Json and Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces stay conditional on netstandard2.0.

openQuestions: Decided (design: Packages): libraries target netstandard2.0 and net10.0, and the netstandard2.0 build keeps a .NET Framework test run on Windows for PSWriteOffice on Windows PowerShell 5.1. Still open: each #if NETFRAMEWORK workaround (Word Save snapshot, Excel non-seekable stream save, PDF NET472 branches) needs a runtime-check replacement proved on .NET Framework 4.7.2.
ExcelReadOptions has 35 properties and drives both the streaming reader and CreateInspectionSnapshot; split reader options from inspection options.
InsertObjects<T> writes a plain range; decide whether AddTable<T> covers that (AsRange option) or a SetValues<T> stays.
